{{Top|leg}}
The '''Director of Republic Strategic Information Service''', or simply '''Director of SIS''', was the title of the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] (SIS). The SIS served as the Republic's primary intelligence agency during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]].
